name: Clipper
feature_notes: Lantern Harbor loads its 1,433,400-byte lesson cartridge when a visitor opens Wonderwake. The launcher verifies the cartridge SHA-256 before displaying the lesson. Fleet payments opens from the Engine, Owner portal and finalized Quartermaster invoices. Its separate payment service handles Stripe Connect checkout, the agreed Admiral share on the pretax USD sale, and the ship and Admiral books.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.

install_step: Open Wonderwake, return to My Fleet, then open Fleet payments from the Engine.
